title: Proposed patterned shadow tranche 2
selectionPrinciple: Stress-test assurance patterns not already covered by S9/K10/K12/K21/K23/S13, using the now-sufficient live corpus including CEA + Gateway layers.

proposedKsbs.whySelected: Classic S9/K10-style risk: Golden A gap may dissolve when emissions teaching + CEA 12.x + GW2AC03 emissions fault are admitted.
proposedKsbs.uncertaintyStressed: Was emissions 'missing' or previously invisible? Does Gateway assessment change practice/assessment axes without resolving Primary?
proposedKsbs.addsBeyondPilot6: Different technical system (emissions) and a Gateway diagnostic assessment pattern not central to pilot.

proposedKsbs.whySelected: Golden A says inspection-to-spec gap, but GW2AC01 + Block inspection tasks + CEA 14.x may show strong assessed inspection practice.
evidenceLayersLikelyAvailable: GW2AC01 safety inspection + assessor fault seeding
proposedKsbs.uncertaintyStressed: Manufacturer data/schedules teaching depth vs inspection practical assessment — may split TEACHING DEPTH vs PRACTICE.
proposedKsbs.addsBeyondPilot6: Inspection skill axis + Gateway seeded-fault assessment design.

proposedKsbs.whySelected: Only distributed-skill exception in Golden A — methodology must handle non-gap, non-single-Primary cases.
proposedKsbs.uncertaintyStressed: Whether distributed classification survives richer evidence or becomes CLEAR Primary.
proposedKsbs.addsBeyondPilot6: Distributed ownership pattern absent from first six.

proposedKsbs.whySelected: HV battery/charger SoH testing is a sharper skill claim than isolation rules/awareness; tests whether EV cluster has mixed outcomes.
proposedKsbs.addsBeyondPilot6: Different EV skill from S13; prevents over-generalising EV KEEP/REVIEW conclusions.

proposedKsbs.whySelected: Behaviour/EDI likely poor in technical packs — stress-tests methodology on non-technical KSBs without forcing false 'taught' claims.
proposedKsbs.uncertaintyStressed: Whether absence is true CURRICULUM GAP vs EVIDENCE_VISIBILITY of pastoral/tutorial materials not in Autocare packs.
proposedKsbs.addsBeyondPilot6: Behaviour pattern; pilot was almost entirely technical.

proposedKsbs.whySelected: FCA/PCI financial compliance — different commercial domain from workshop practicals.
proposedKsbs.uncertaintyStressed: Adjacency of sales teaching vs explicit FCA/PCI requirements.

patternTests: suspension vs steering adjacency with K10
proposedKsbs.whySelected: Strong-structure control adjacent to K10; CEA 5.x/11.x suspension tasks and alignment Gateways must not steal or confuse ownership.
proposedKsbs.uncertaintyStressed: False remap risk from later advanced suspension/ADAS CEAs.
proposedKsbs.addsBeyondPilot6: KEEP control in suspension domain (pilot used brakes/EV).
